options.units.note: These change how lengths are displayed. The drawing's own insertion units are set with the UNITS command; inches or millimeters for electrical symbols under Drafting Settings > Drawing Units (WDUNITS).

dsettings.units.rescale: Rescale existing objects so they keep their real size

dsettings.units.willScale.one: {count} object will be scaled by {factor} about the origin.

dsettings.units.keep: Existing objects keep their coordinates; only new symbols, ladders and wire numbers use the new units.
dsettings.units.noChange: The drawing already uses these units.
dsettings.units.note: Sets $INSUNITS and the WD_M block's UNITS value. Metric drawings insert library symbols at 25.4, use 3.175 mm wire numbers and lay ladders out in millimeters (25 mm rungs, 230 mm wide by default). See docs/METRIC.md.
